effect_description_eng:
＜Overclock ([Chuumon]/[Sukamon] in name)＞ (At the end of your turn, by deleting 1 of your Tokens or other specified Digimon, this Digimon attacks a player without suspending.)
[Security] [On Play] [When Digivolving] To 1 of your opponent's Digimon, give -3000 DP for the turn for each of your Digimon with [Chuumon], [Sukamon] or [Etemon] in their names.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When any of your other Digimon with [Chuumon], [Sukamon] or [Etemon] in their names are played, ＜De-Digivolve 1＞ 1 of your opponent's Digimon. (Trash the top card. You can't trash past level 3 cards.)

Assembly Requirements [Assembly -3] Lv.4 Digimon card w/[Sukamon] in name
